command:
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; gts9_capture=$(cat /sys/module/gts9_lastactivity/parameters/capture_id); printf "capture=%s
" "$gts9_capture"; cat /sys/module/gts9_pnmi_test/parameters/enable; cat /sys/module/gts9_pnmi_test/parameters/status; timeout 5 systemctl --failed --no-pager; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
